posts.title: death of curiosity
posts.description: While looking for a old keyboard in store room , I found my old notebook from high school. Going thought the notebook I realized that , I'm not a curious person anymore. That notebook is full of question's like are planets in a same plane ( x-y ) do we all see the same colors While wasting time on youtube, i may have seen video on similar topic or maybe even complex.
